name: review-net10-compatibility
prompt: Review an upgraded WPF project for .NET 10 and C# 14 compatibility issues, including XAML resources, WPF and WinForms interop, and compiler behavior changes.
rubric: Checks net10.0-windows, UseWPF, empty Grid definition collections, and DynamicResource validity.
Checks WPF/WinForms type ambiguity and relevant C# 14 contextual-keyword or overload changes.
Records whether each changed behavior is adopted, adapted, deferred, or blocks migration.
